subject: Refactor NotificationPanelMessageWriter to reduce cognitive complexity
body:
Refactor NotificationPanelMessageWriter to reduce cognitive complexity

Extract EnsureHandleCreated and InvokeOnCorrectThread helper methods
from AddToList to bring cognitive complexity below SonarCloud S3776
threshold of 15.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Cosmetic cognitive-complexity refactor of OUR defensive handle-creation code (fork copied it). No behavior gain; subtly widens exception swallowing. Churn on crash-sensitive path not worth it.
